item.title: Intuitive Derivations in DSP
item.description: One of the most important concepts in digital signal processing is that a Linear-Time-Invariant (LTI) system is completely characterized in the time-domain by the output response to a unit impulse input.

item.title: Complex Envelope
item.description: There are two common methods in the literature for mathematically describing narrowband signals. Both of these methods will be encountered in popular signal processing, digital communications, and radar signal processing books.
